verses.1: A psalm of David. O you sons of the mighty, give to the LORD, give to the LORD glory and strength.
verses.2: Give to the LORD the glory of His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of holiness.
verses.3: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory has thundered— the LORD over the mighty waters.
verses.4: The voice of the LORD is in power, the voice of the LORD in majesty.
verses.5: The voice of the LORD shatters cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon,
verses.6: and makes them leap like a calf of Lebanon, like a young bull among the forest.
verses.7: The voice of the LORD splits the flames of fire.
verses.8: The voice of the LORD convulses the wilderness; the LORD convulses the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.9: The voice of the LORD causes the deer to calve; the LORD strips the forests bare, and in His temple all say, "Glory!"
verses.10: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD sits as king forever.
verses.11: The LORD gives strength to His people; the LORD blesses His people with peace.

notes:
Notes
- v. 1: "sons of the mighty" (בְּנֵי אֵלִים) — a poetic designation for divine or exalted beings, often translated as "sons of God" but here rendered more naturally in context.
- v. 8: "wilderness of Kadesh" (מִדְבַּר קָדֵשׁ) — Kadesh is a known geographic location in the wilderness; it is treated as a proper name here.
raw:
[1] A psalm of David. O you sons of the mighty, give to the LORD, give to the LORD glory and strength.

[2] Give to the LORD the glory of His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of holiness.

[3] The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory has thundered— the LORD over the mighty waters.

[4] The voice of the LORD is in power, the voice of the LORD in majesty.

[5] The voice of the LORD shatters cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon,

[6] and makes them leap like a calf of Lebanon, like a young bull among the forest.

[7] The voice of the LORD splits the flames of fire.

[8] The voice of the LORD convulses the wilderness; the LORD convulses the wilderness of Kadesh.

[9] The voice of the LORD causes the deer to calve; the LORD strips the forests bare, and in His temple all say, "Glory!"

[10] The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD sits as king forever.

[11] The LORD gives strength to His people; the LORD blesses His people with peace.

Notes
- v. 1: "sons of the mighty" (בְּנֵי אֵלִים) — a poetic designation for divine or exalted beings, often translated as "sons of God" but here rendered more naturally in context.
- v. 8: "wilderness of Kadesh" (מִדְבַּר קָדֵשׁ) — Kadesh is a known geographic location in the wilderness; it is treated as a proper name here.
